page_title: BOU 2-0 NEW | Bournemouth v Newcastle 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.

90+7' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Nick Pope makes a great save to stop his effort.
90+6' Here is a change. Marcus Tavernier is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth).
90+5' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joe Willock walks off the pitch to be replaced by Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd).
90+2' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Bournemouth, play can continue.
87' There's a break in play and referee Chris Kavanagh must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bournemouth using VAR. This could be interesting!
86' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
86' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
86' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
85' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
84' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
84' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. Good work from Bournemouth as they win a corner.
81' The substitution is prepared. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antoine Semenyo.
75' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Chris Kavanagh signals that there was no handball and the goal stands! The Bournemouth players celebrate.
74' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.
73' 2 - 0 After a goalmouth scramble the ball rebounds out to Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) who buries it from close range into the left side of the goal.
72' Bournemouth have a corner.

71' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Nick Pope has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Bournemouth win a corner.
70' Looks like Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) coming on for Justin Kluivert.
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Adam Smith.
66' Substitution. Ben Parkinson (Newcastle Utd) on for Lewis Miley.
65' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) picks up an injury.

64' Neto makes a brilliant save! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
60' 1 - 0 Goal! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
59' It seemed like Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
57' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
54' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
52' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
51' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' Eddie Howe has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) comes on the pitch for Lewis Hall.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+4' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45+1' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is able to continue to play.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
42' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
41' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

40' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
38' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
36' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
35' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) will take the free kick.
31' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) launches a cross from the corner, but Nick Pope is alert to thwart the effort.
31' Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch because Miguel Almiron simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
30' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

28' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Nick Pope easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bournemouth.
27' The referee awards a corner and Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.
26' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
21' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
19' The game is interrupted now, Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Neto.
16' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
14' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
13' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Bournemouth will take a throw-in.
12' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) leaps to collect the ball.
11' A great run by Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.

9' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Neto! Newcastle get a corner.
7' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) works the corner short.
7' The ball is cleared after Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

3' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
1' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Nick Pope is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Chris Kavanagh.
